decisions.reason: This compact rotating dumper builds on the firm's core offer and still has its own page, so the investment and visible commitment are worth defending.
The articulated dumper is core construction equipment with continued dedicated presentation, so dropping it would write off established development effort.

The rescue vehicle has been downgraded from its own page to a mention, but it is a niche, safety-relevant product with substantial engineering invested, and its slow uptake can still be blamed on long mining procurement cycles.
The compact telescopic loader extends the established range, keeps its own page, and the firm has invested heavily and visibly in it.
The material lift is reported as a long-standing rental favorite and recently won a large order, so there is no reason to drop it.
The mining loader has a dedicated page and publicly reported operating success of 1,000 hours in seven months, which reinforces the firm's commitment to it.
